name: dartograph
description: Dependency-graph evidence queries for Dart: dead code, dependency hygiene, and duplication findings as Problems.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, dartograph uses only your user settings for dartograph.executable, dartograph.args, and dartograph.runOnSave. Trust the workspace to apply its own dartograph.args and dartograph.runOnSave.

commands.title: dartograph: Check Impact of Current File

dartograph.executable.description: The dartograph executable (dart pub global activate dartograph): an absolute path or a command name on PATH. Relative paths are rejected. It can be set only in user or remote settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

dartograph.runOnSave.description: Re-run the analysis a short delay after a Dart file is saved.

dartograph.minTokens.description: Minimum duplicated token window reported by `dartograph dup`.

dartograph.args.description: Extra arguments appended to every dartograph invocation. The default keeps the incremental fact cache in dartograph's per-user cache directory, outside the workspace, so re-runs stay fast without trusting cache files a repository could commit. It needs a dartograph CLI newer than 0.16.2.
